title: Predator Realizes There Was No 15-Year-Old Girl
description:
Bodycam shows New Mexico police confronting a 28-year-old man who was expecting to meet up with a 15-year-old girl. Police said Rafael Rosas messaged an agent posing as a teen girl online, even saying the conversation felt "Chris Hansen-y." Rosas' instincts failed him when he showed up and got a wake-up call. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
